name: robogsim-evaluation-scope
reviewedBy: Round-6 prose repair implementer, not independent acceptance
rationale: The 2026-09-27 RL motion pass replaced the RoboGSim sentence 'This evaluation is not interchangeable with real-robot testing.' with 'This evaluation uses simulated trials as well as real-robot testing, with different outcomes.', which puts real-robot testing inside the simulated evaluation. The retained RoboGSim v2 body, as the corrected robogsim-2024 row of audit/rl-sim2real.md records, keeps the two apart and reports 90% real-robot versus 30% RoboGSim placement for the same real-data-trained model. The restore replaces only that sentence with 'This simulated evaluation cannot stand in for real-robot testing.'. Every other sentence, number, citation (in order), mount and the frontmatter are byte-preserved. The archived pre-restore bytes are exactly the current endpoint the unchanged RL motion continuity review records, and that review still gates them; the live article keeps every phrase that review and the industrial-release dependency review require of this page. No proof, receipt, verdict or ledger cell changed.
